content_of_post_to_comment:
I think I'm disciplined and consistent, I previously had done #100DaysOfCode and other stuffs like 30 days no caffeine. And I'm currently on Day 23 of #150DaysOfCode and Day 23 of No Fap.

I know i have potential but still I'm only able to achieve less in more time and i think the reason is because i lack Plan...

No I have a goal is to finish MERN stack till the end of the year, but no plan !

I am consistently doing MERN and DSA everyday but lack of Plan makes me slow :(

The problems I face are -

> If i set a goal and make a plan for next 4 months than i struggle to allocate time - i gets confused that how much time i should give to a particular topic and how many days / weeks should i spend on that

> even if i allocate time then i face another issue which is - what if i can't able to finish it in this time period and if i try to finish it in within time block then i might loose the quality and instead focus on quantity :(
comment: Planning can actually become another form of procrastination if you try to predict every detail. For MERN and DSA, I’d probably plan around outcomes instead of hours: e.g., build a project by a certain date, finish a set of problems, then adjust based on reality. A plan should be a map, not a contract you fail by missing a day.
